svg.text: Sheet 1 rev 2 — Power bench, 120 W, 48 V → 12 V (scaled from MODEL.md v0.4.4; every value is measured before the first fault run)

rev 2, 2026-10-08: both breakers high-side with isolated drivers · freewheel diode D_fw · TVS on Q_brk · F2 moved to the converter output · 100 V parts on the 48 V side · supply (−) bonded to the star. Option-C-only parts dashed (scope option B = rack-side faults only).
FEEDER BREAKER — option C only (option B: wire link)
high side, gate from U18 isolated driver (Sheet 3)
R_f 22 Ω 50 W (or 39 Ω) · L_f 8 µH air
Q_f8 IRFB4110 (100 V) · D_fwA small Schottky across R+L
gate ← one-shot A (10 ms) via U16
current capped by the supply CC limit (4.4 A)
before any relay test: (a) holds 14 A ≥ 10 ms
fits the loss model (d) starts into 66 mF
(e) pre-bias safe: no reverse current when
★ STAR GROUND — every return, both node grounds, supply (−) and the scope clips meet here
STORAGE BANK C1·C2·C3 22 mF 16 V low-ESR = 66 mF (sweep point 58 mF)
bank ESR + ballast = 19 mΩ measured · D_rp 40 V 20 A reverse protection
RACK BREAKER = SSCB emulation, high side ①
gate ← U19 isolated driver + iso DC-DC
default closed while the node runs (TRIP = 0)
LOAD BANK Q_L1..Q_L5 — 40 V ≤ 10 mΩ N-FETs (12 V gate drive from U10–U14; no logic-level needed)
staircase ramps and two-tier cadence from the bench control; all on = 10 A; fan-cooled heatsink, 90 °C thermal switch in the driver enable
RACK-SIDE FAULT INJECTOR: R_f48 select = (63 mΩ − coil DCR) / 0.33 Ω / 1.2 Ω, 50 W pulse-rated · L_f48 select 10 / 30 / 100 µH air (130 A, no saturation)
Q_f48 IRFP7430 low side, gate ← one-shot B (5 ms hardware limit) via U17 · D_fw Schottky ≥ 30 A / few-hundred-A surge across R_f48 + L_f48: anode at Q_f48 drain,
cathode at the 12 V node — carries the coil current when Q_f48 turns off AND when Q_brk opens; reverse-biased during the fault, so the relay sees nothing of it ②

Colours: blue = feeder node measurement, orange = rack node measurement, red = fault branches and breakers, dashed = option C only. Fault resistors and coils: one value wired, the others on a terminal block; every element (C, ESR, L, DCR, shunts, wiring) measured and entered into PARAMS_BENCH.

Power-up order ⑦: 1 nodes + bench control on USB (TRIP = 0 → breakers close) → 2 driver adapter on → 3 K1 closed with the supply OUTPUT OFF → 4 supply output on (its ramp precharges C_bus / C_in; no 200 A inrush, C_in stays far below 63 V) → 5 arm key only for a fault run. Reflash with the output off.

Not built: bolted 800 V-side faults (Layer 1; abusive to the supply). The supply must hold constant current at 4.4 A during a feeder-side fault, not shut down. No isolation (common ground); the product needs it. Scope ground clips only on the star; feeder-side quantities by differential probe.

Hazards: 4.2 J in the bank + 0.15 J on the bus (burn / spatter at the fault switch, not a shock hazard); ≤ 130 A for ≤ 5 ms by the hardware one-shot; fault runs with a second person present and the professor's sign-off.
